title: What is the Context API and when does it cause performance issues?
description: Understand React Context and its performance implications.

data.text: **Question:** What is the Context API and when does it cause performance issues?

React Context provides a way to pass data through the component tree without prop drilling. It causes performance issues when the context value changes frequently, causing all consuming components to re-render.

**Context API:**
- Provider supplies value to consumers
- useContext hook reads context
- Avoids prop drilling
- Useful for theme, locale, auth

**Performance Issues:**
- Every consumer re-renders when value changes
- New object literals cause unnecessary re-renders
- Large trees re-render unnecessarily
- Can split context by concern

items: How do you optimize Context performance?
When should you use Context vs state management?

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: All consumers re-render on value change
data.takeaway: Use Context for low-frequency updates like theme and auth. Use state management for high-frequency updates.
